purpose: G1/G2 ground 5000-pair benchmark: GMC certified planner vs gs3d lattice A*, sweeper and cylinder, same pairs. Frozen before any planner run; see docs/ground5k_design.md.

contact.rule: constant floor reference z_floor (GMC band origin, gs3d A5 manifold); admissible where |fitted floor - z_floor| <= max_height_error_m (gs3d_run._constant_floor_support)

crop.stair_note: R is the box cut by the contact strip as an axis-aligned staircase of 0.10 m y-bands inside the strip (GMC I3 overlay exactness; design §2.1).
crop.box: bbox(start, goal, sweeper witness, cylinder witness) + pad, clipped to scene extent; region R = box ∩ contact strip; one crop per pair shared by all four combinations

evidence.note: a cell is observed floor if the level-2 xy support box of an opaque source-capture splat centred within [-0.30, +0.10] m of the fitted floor touches it; splats with half-extent > 0.5 m are ignored. The centre-count version (first run, job 18487348) left pinholes in open floor.

per_query.memory_cap_rule: child cap = min(memory_cap_gb, task memory - 1.5 GB); task memory per combination from pilot sacct MaxRSS x 1.5, rounded up (A* 6 GB, GMC sweeper 8 GB, GMC cylinder 12 GB -> child cap 10.5 GB; pilot max child RSS 7.3 GB)
per_query.note: cap covers crop + preparation/projection + compile + query + certification; the replay is outside it

budget.max_wall_s: wall_cap_s minus time already spent on this query

astar.provenance: resolution/margin of experiments/gs3d_integration.py ground runs; counts = its cylinder 'real diagnostic ceiling' (gs3d_integration.py:244)

gmc.query_max_wall_seconds: wall_cap_s minus time already spent on this query (height_showcase.yaml 7200 s never binds)
gmc.band_note: GMC projects with its robot band inflated by margin_m (the shared replay margin), because its band test drops a splat lying wholly outside the band however close it is; horizontally its eps_clear 2 mm already exceeds the margin. Added after the pilot (design §2).

replay.authority: gmc.gs3d.trajectory.replay_plan on a fresh PreparedScene of the same query SceneSpec
replay.gmc_path_conversion: GMC PoseCurve knots -> xy polyline -> rotate-in-place + heading translation (gs3d.planner._linear_trajectory); exact for circular bodies
